seoTitle: Piano moving in Brussels and Walloon Brabant
seoDesc: Entrust the complex move of your upright or grand piano to the experts at Gérard & Fils for a reliable and 100% secure service.
h1: Entrust us with moving your piano in Brussels, Walloon Brabant and Flemish Brabant

body.p: Having a piano at home is a real privilege: it lets you live your passion for music to the full while adding a touch of elegance to your interior. This exceptional instrument blends harmoniously with your décor and furniture.

However, when it comes to moving, transporting it can be complex because of its weight, size and fragility. For a safe move of your piano, trust the experience of Gérard & Fils. Our team of professionals offers tailored services and supports you with expert advice to ensure a worry-free move, whether it is a piano move in Brussels, Walloon Brabant or Flemish Brabant.

sections.h: Why entrust your piano move to specialists?

body.p: Whether upright or grand, a piano remains an instrument as precious as it is delicate to transport. Because of its weight, imposing size and fragility, trying to move it without an experienced removal company carries real risks, both for the instrument and for your own safety. That is why our company provides removers who are trained and equipped to handle this type of item with the greatest care. Thanks to their technical mastery, they take care of every stage: protection, moving, passage up and down stairs or through windows, and secure transport to the address of your choice, whether in Brussels, Walloon Brabant or Flemish Brabant.

Our service can also include hiring a furniture lift to ease the piano's passage through a window or balcony when access by the stairs is impossible or too risky. Besides the piano, our removers can handle your other bulky furniture with the same level of care. By choosing our company, you benefit from genuine experience in specialist moving, combined with professional equipment and tailored support, for a reliable, fast service with no nasty surprises.
On arrival, we assess the quickest and safest way to transport your piano. Depending on the situation, the move may be carried out via the stairs, using an outdoor lift or a crane.

We inspect the instrument according to the type of piano and, where necessary, dismantle it, which is compulsory for a grand piano. We then fully pack the piano and any dismantled parts to prevent any knocks or scratches.

Thanks to our suitable equipment and the know-how of our specialist removers, we handle and load the piano without the slightest risk, adapting flexibly and professionally to the layout of the premises.
We take the piano to its destination and assess the situation again on site to determine the best way of moving the instrument with complete peace of mind, using the right equipment.

We unpack and reassemble the piano in the room of your choice, taking care to respect its integrity and protect your home. Thanks to our expertise and suitable equipment, even awkward access or high floors are no obstacle.

In addition to our expertise in piano moving, we offer a personalised service to meet your specific needs. Whether you are moving into an apartment in central Brussels or a house with difficult access in Walloon or Flemish Brabant, our team adapts flexibly to your situation to ensure a worry-free move.

We can take care of the administrative formalities linked to transporting your piano, notably the parking permits for the lift and the truck, to be requested from the local municipality, at both the departure and arrival addresses.
By choosing Gérard & Fils for your piano move in Walloon Brabant or in a Brussels municipality, you benefit from a specialist company and experienced removers who provide tailor-made services.
Our company does everything possible to make your piano move simple and stress-free. We provide a careful, rigorous service at every stage, ensuring the safety and integrity of your instrument.

Need expert advice or a professional opinion to choose the best transport solution? Need a lift for high-level access? Whether you want more information about our removal services or about hiring suitable equipment to move your piano safely, contact us today by phone or through our online form for a free, no-obligation quote. Enjoy competitive prices and entrust your piano to experts who will look after it as if it were their own!
